import.title: Import bulk SQL
import.description: Reads a local SQL file incrementally and builds a statement digest; the 32 MiB file and 512 KiB per-statement limits are pre-checked locally — the server result remains the final judgement.
import.pickHint: Pick a .sql or .txt file, or paste content into the editor
import.dropTitle: Drop SQL file here to import
import.dropHint: Only .sql and .txt files are accepted, up to 32 MiB.
import.limitsHint: Limits: file 32 MiB · statement 512 KiB · 100,000 statements
import.cancelledDescription: Reading was aborted; the draft content is unchanged.
import.truncatedDescription: The file may be truncated; the server may treat this as a parse failure.
import.okDescription: On confirm the SQL content is loaded into the editor locally; it is persisted to the server only when you save the draft or submit the order.

fileTooLarge.title: File exceeds the 32 MiB limit
fileTooLarge.description: Actual {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the file and import in batches.

statementTooLarge.title: Statements above the 512 KiB limit found
statementTooLarge.description: {{count}} oversized statements (e.g. statement #{{samples}}), largest {{actual}} bytes, limit {{limit}} bytes. Split the statement.

tooManyStatements.title: More than 100,000 statements
tooManyStatements.description: Actual {{actual}} statements, limit {{limit}}. Split by table or statement range into multiple drafts.

browser.emptyDescription: Import a SQL file or load the SQL content to browse SQL fingerprints and statements in a virtualized list.
browser.localNote: Grouping is a browser-side shape digest for navigation only; the authoritative fingerprint grouping comes from the server review.
browser.revealFirst: The draft has SQL that is not loaded yet: use “Load SQL” to build the browsing digest.

capacity.warningDescription: A high fingerprint count means the model must review more representative samples — expect longer precheck duration and higher token usage.
capacity.splitTitle: Split recommended: {{count}} unique fingerprints exceed the {{limit}} limit
capacity.splitDescription: Split the SQL by table, schema or statement range so each draft stays within {{warning}} unique fingerprints, otherwise the review cannot complete.

list.title: My Orders

list.draftsCardDescription: {{total}} draft(s) to continue — click a row to resume
list.draftsEmpty: No drafts yet. Pick a flow from "Submit order" to start.
list.draftsDeleteDescription: The draft, its SQL and its review records are deleted together. This cannot be undone.
list.executionEmpty: No orders are waiting for your execution.

filter.searchPlaceholder: Search order no. / title, or filter by field
filter.emptyFiltered: No orders match the current filters.

detail.title: Order detail
detail.activityHint: Timeline, comments and the frozen snapshot
detail.frozenNote: Revision, flow and review snapshot are immutable after submission; SQL plaintext requires an explicit audited reveal.

timelineEvents.orderSubmitted: Order submitted and workflow snapshot frozen
timelineEvents.stageReadyForExecution: Final approval granted; awaiting frozen executor
timelineEvents.executionScheduled: Scheduled execution created by executor (runs on time; never retried if missed)
timelineEvents.executionScheduleCancelled: Scheduled execution cancelled by executor; order returned to pending execution
timelineEvents.executionPartialFailed: Stage partially failed (applied DDL statements retained)
timelineEvents.executionResultUnknown: Execution result unknown; awaiting manual verification
timelineEvents.nodeInvalidated: Frozen approval or execution node has no active candidates; order moved to invalid

detail.withdrawDescription: The current stage has not started executing; the order terminates as "Withdrawn". Frozen actors and existing records are kept.
detail.withdrawPartialDescription: A stage already started executing or the result is unknown; the withdrawal is recorded as "Withdrawn after partial execution".
detail.voidDescription: Voiding terminates every step that has not executed; completed approvals and executions are retained and never rolled back.
detail.partialWarningTitle: Applied changes cannot roll back automatically
detail.partialWarningDescription: A prior stage executed successfully or its result is unknown. After withdrawal the state becomes "Withdrawn after partial execution"; applied database changes stay and need manual remediation.
detail.invalidDescription: Frozen reviewers were removed; this order can no longer be approved. Only the submitter may void it.
detail.frozenReviewNote: Findings come from the review snapshot frozen at submission (see the precheck overview for the real AI identity and usage); approval never re-runs the AI review.
detail.commentsEmptyHint: Press Enter to send the first comment

sql.title: Frozen SQL revision
sql.revealNote: Plaintext requires an explicit reveal, is watermarked with the viewer identity and stays valid for 5 minutes; every reveal and copy is audited.
sql.copyFailed: Copy failed: the clipboard write did not complete. Try again.
sql.copyAuditFailed: Copied to the clipboard, but the copy audit failed to record: {{detail}}

rollback.title: Rollback SQL
rollback.isRollbackOrderDescription: This ticket executes verified inverse SQL and validates live database row/schema preconditions before applying changes.
rollback.revealHint: Rollback SQL is deterministically generated from verified before/after images or schema snapshots; every reveal and copy is watermarked and audited.
rollback.draftCreatedToast: Rollback draft created; run precheck and submit for approval
rollback.conflictAlertTitle: Rollback conflict or execution failure detected
rollback.rolledBackAlertDescription: This change order has been restored to its prior state by a completed rollback ticket.

statusDescription.not_requested: Rollback protection was not enabled when this ticket was submitted.
statusDescription.pending: Rollback evidence and inverse SQL will be captured automatically when execution completes.
statusDescription.available: Verified rollback evidence is durably stored; you can inspect the rollback SQL or generate a rollback ticket with one click.
statusDescription.unsupported: Contains SQL statements that cannot be deterministically reversed.
statusDescription.evidence_incomplete: Rollback evidence could not be completely verified; automatic rollback ticket generation is blocked for safety.
statusDescription.conflicted: Current database state diverges from the post-execution image; automatic rollback was blocked.
statusDescription.rollback_in_progress: A generated rollback ticket is currently in approval or execution.
statusDescription.rolled_back: The generated rollback ticket completed successfully.
statusDescription.rollback_failed: The previous rollback ticket did not complete; you may generate a new rollback ticket after investigating.

execution.actionNote: Only the executors frozen at submission may execute or schedule; approval never auto-executes.
execution.semanticsNote: DML: one transaction per stage — any failure rolls the stage back and terminates the order. DDL: non-transactional, in order — failure preserves prior successes and marks partial_failed.
execution.dmlSemanticsNote: DML: one transaction per stage — any failure rolls the stage back and terminates the order.
execution.confirmDescription: Execution uses the frozen SQL revision the approval signed off; executors cannot change the SQL, target or options.
execution.ddlWarningDescription: DDL runs statement by statement without a transaction: statements after a failure never run, prior successes are kept, and the order ends partial_failed. The same order cannot be retried.
execution.scheduleLabel: Deferred execution (one system run at due time)
execution.scheduleCreated: Scheduled for {{time}}; a missed due time is marked missed and never catches up.
execution.preflightPending: Preflight in progress: SQL hash, revision and approval snapshot consistency pending.
execution.preflightHashOk: Preflight confirmed: the executed SQL is identical to the approved SQL (same hash).
execution.statementsError: Failed to load the statement ledger.
execution.liveNote: Execution in progress — results refresh by polling.
execution.cancelDescription: Cancellation is a request, not a promise: DML rolls the stage back and terminates the order; DDL stops later statements and keeps successes; an unconfirmed cancellation ends in the unknown-result verification path.
execution.verifyTitle: Unknown execution result — manual verification required
execution.verifyDescription: The database returned no definitive answer: this is neither success nor not-executed. Pick a fixed verdict backed by database-side evidence; the original attempt is permanently barred from re-execution.
execution.verifyWaitingTitle: Unknown execution result — waiting for the frozen executor
execution.verifyWaitingDescription: Only the frozen executors of this stage may verify; admin cannot verify on their behalf.
execution.evidencePlaceholder: e.g. row counts / SHOW SLAVE STATUS excerpt / ticket link
execution.copyDescription: This execution cannot be retried on the same order: copy to a new draft and re-run the full AI review and approval pipeline.
execution.copyDialogDescription: Copies the SQL reference, title and flow only; review, approvals and execution facts are never copied.
execution.schedulePrefilled: Prefilled from the submitter's desired time; confirm or adjust.
execution.scheduledNote: Runs automatically once at {{time}}; a missed due time is never caught up.
execution.scheduledCancelNote: Any frozen executor of this stage may cancel: the order returns to pending execution for a fresh schedule or an immediate run. A server restart does not affect a not-yet-due schedule.
execution.cancelScheduleDescription: The order returns to pending execution and will not run automatically at the planned time; schedule again or execute immediately.
execution.waitNote: This stage is approved. Only the frozen executors ({{names}}) can run it; everyone else waits for the outcome.
execution.scheduleLeadHint: The scheduled time must be at least 5 minutes in the future (blocked client-side; no backend error needed).
execution.oscOverridesToggle: Customize gh-ost parameters for this attempt (optional)
execution.oscOverridesHint: Applies to MySQL ALTER TABLE online schema changes only; blank fields inherit the global gh-ost defaults.
execution.ddlModeGhOstHint: Copies rows in throttled chunks with replication lag and load protection; ideal for table-rebuilding ALTER TABLE.
execution.ddlModeOnlineDdlHint: Executes directly via MySQL InnoDB native Online DDL; ideal for instant column additions or secondary indexes.

failureReasons.ROLLBACK_UNSUPPORTED: Rollback protection aborted before sending SQL (statement unsupported for automatic rollback)
failureReasons.ROLLBACK_CONFLICT: Target table data diverged from rollback snapshot; execution aborted
failureReasons.ROLLBACK_AMBIGUOUS: Transaction rollback confirmation is uncertain; manual verification required
failureReasons.CANCEL_NOT_CONFIRMED: Cancellation was not confirmed by the database; manual verification required
failureReasons.COMMIT_ACK_LOST: Commit acknowledgement lost; outcome unknown, manual verification required
failureReasons.RECLAIM_AFTER_SEND: Execution lease reclaimed after send; outcome unknown, manual verification required
failureReasons.DML_STATEMENT_FAILED: DML statement failed; stage transaction rolled back
failureReasons.DML_EXECUTION_AMBIGUOUS: DML execution outcome ambiguous; manual verification required
failureReasons.DDL_STATEMENT_FAILED: DDL statement failed; remaining statements stopped
failureReasons.DDL_EXECUTION_AMBIGUOUS: DDL execution outcome ambiguous; manual verification required
failureReasons.LEDGER_INCONSISTENT: Execution ledger inconsistency; manual verification required
failureReasons.parse_error: SQL syntax error rejected by database
failureReasons.data_type_mismatch: Data type or literal value mismatch
failureReasons.unique_violation: Unique or primary key constraint violation
failureReasons.object_already_exists: Target table, index, or column already exists
failureReasons.connection_failed: Failed to connect to target database (SQL not sent)
failureReasons.connection_open_failed: Failed to open target database connection (SQL not sent)
failureReasons.pool_unreachable: Target datasource pool unreachable (SQL not sent)
failureReasons.schema_context_failed: Target schema context check failed; aborted before execution
failureReasons.postgres_search_path_changed: PostgreSQL search_path check failed; aborted before execution
failureReasons.driver_error: Target database returned an execution error
failureReasons.capability_target_unsupported: Operation unsupported by target database engine or version

detail.description: Request reason, frozen datasource set and terminal facts.

queue.title: Awaiting my decision
queue.searchPlaceholder: Search order no. / title / state / submitter / datasource
queue.frozenNote: Approvals reuse the review snapshot frozen at submission; neither this page nor any approval action re-runs the AI review.

decision.frozenReviewNote: Judge against the frozen review snapshot from submission and the SQL shown on this page.
decision.approveDescription: Approval advances the flow stage by stage; after the final step the order enters execution-pending and is executed separately by the frozen executor — never automatically.
decision.rejectDescription: A rejection by any reviewer immediately rejects the whole order; all remaining steps are voided. This cannot be undone.
decision.commentLabel: Comment (required for rejection; recorded in the approval timeline)
decision.conflictHint: The page was refreshed to the latest state; please check it and retry.

queryAccess.title: Query access approvals
queryAccess.description: Approve datasource access eligibility for query flows — never SQL (Q001).
queryAccess.searchPlaceholder: Search requester / datasources / state / submitted time
queryAccess.grantsSearchPlaceholder: Search grant owner / state / expires at
queryAccess.pendingDescription: Requests related to the current user through frozen reviewer snapshots.
queryAccess.approveDescription: Final approval creates a grant covering exactly the requested datasource set.
queryAccess.rejectDescription: Rejection is immediate; the requester must submit a new request.

reasoning.sql_optimize:
1. Scope Gate: Verified request is within SQL performance analysis and index optimization (sql_optimize).
2. Privacy Anonymization: Built ephemeral per-turn token mapping for identifiers and literals with zero raw data egress.
3. Evidence Grounding: Analyzed authorized schema catalog, index metadata, and execution plan signals to produce verification steps.
reasoning.sql_generate:
1. Scope Gate: Verified request is within governed single-statement SQL draft generation (sql_generate).
2. Schema Alignment: Generated structured SQL draft against the desensitized table catalog of the authorized datasource and schema.
3. AST Validation & Restoration: Verified single-statement AST, blocked high-risk statements, and restored identifiers.
reasoning.platform_help:
1. Scope Gate: Verified request is within YearningX platform usage and troubleshooting (platform_help).
2. Knowledge Retrieval: Matched role-visible v4.0.0 platform guides and route entries.
3. Structured Synthesis: Produced GFM Markdown operational guidance with navigable citations.
